briefs.title: Camp kettle
briefs.brief: A squat tea kettle with an open overhead handle and a distinct side spout.

raw-luna.observation: Two dark uprights flank the lid and a square outlet clears the body. The missing visible arch makes it read as a pail.

guided-terra.observation: The squat pot and pronounced angled spout read at game size. The tall dark handle looks almost like one narrow post through the turn.

guided-luna.observation: The dark hoop crosses a squat lidded vessel and a side spout clears the rim. Its thin pointed tip is easy to lose in profile.

reviewed-luna.observation: The dark hoop crosses a squat lidded vessel and a side spout clears the rim. Its thin pointed tip is easy to lose in profile.

briefs.title: Storm lantern
briefs.brief: A portable storm lantern with a warm glowing chamber and a carry loop above the cap.

guided-terra.observation: The cap, translucent-looking chamber and large open loop read as a lantern. The illuminated chamber is cool mint.

guided-luna.observation: The loop and cap suggest a lantern. A broad solid gray skirt obscures the light, and the orange cap carries most of the warm color.

raw-luna.observation: A warm overhanging roof and open loop identify a lantern, but the chamber underneath looks solid gray.

reviewed-luna.observation: The larger contrasting chamber reads more clearly but still glows cool turquoise.

briefs.title: Watering can
briefs.brief: A garden watering can with a long pouring spout and a handle opposite it.

guided-luna.observation: The projecting rose and open grip on the other side give the can a recognizable profile. The spout could extend farther.

guided-terra.observation: A long green spout ending in a pale rose faces away from the dark loop. The slim loop nearly disappears against the backdrop.

raw-luna.observation: The spout and rose read well. The handle bridges the top of the container and leaves the opposite side bare.

reviewed-luna.observation: A longer connected spout separates the rose from the vessel while the opposing grip stays open.

briefs.title: Camp stove
briefs.brief: A single-burner camp stove with a visible cooking grate and a side-mounted fuel tank.

guided-terra.observation: The brown side canister projects from a stove housing, but the flat black hotplate appears solid.

raw-luna.observation: An elevated square pot support exposes the bright burner, with the separate side tank visible through the turn. The support is thin at game size.

guided-luna.observation: A dark lidded case dominates the silhouette. Neither a burner nor its grate is identifiable on top.

reviewed-luna.observation: The raised square grate and exposed orange burner are identifiable beside the mounted canister.

briefs.title: Berry basket
briefs.brief: A harvest basket with a high arch handle and a heap of distinct berries peeking over the rim.

guided-luna.observation: The high handle and tapered open basket read clearly. One bright berry shows above the load and most of the others merge into the interior.

guided-terra.observation: Several distinct berries sit in a contrasting rim beneath a high loop. The handle is unusually thin compared with the basket.

raw-luna.observation: The squared arch identifies a basket, but the flat rim merges into the fruit and only one central shape reads as a berry.

reviewed-luna.observation: The high handle and tapered open basket read clearly. One bright berry shows above the load and most of the others merge into the interior.

briefs.title: Trail pack
briefs.brief: A freestanding ranger backpack with a horizontal bedroll across its top and two contrasting straps.

raw-luna.observation: A front pocket and two straps read as a pack. The chamfered rectangular slab at the top has little sign of a rolled bed.

guided-luna.observation: The brown column and upright load form a narrow silhouette. The top and single dark pouch give little evidence of the horizontal bedroll and two straps.

guided-terra.observation: Long contrasting strap marks suggest a pack. A vertical pointed mass sits on top in place of a horizontal roll.

reviewed-luna.observation: The brown column and upright load form a narrow silhouette. The top and single dark pouch give little evidence of the horizontal bedroll and two straps.

briefs.title: Tide compass
briefs.brief: An open pocket compass with a hinged lid and a bold directional needle on its face.

guided-terra.observation: The dial and raised hinged cover read as a compass. The short marks on the face are too slight to read as a bold directional needle.

raw-luna.observation: The needle and pale dial appear in larger views. Its large horizontal lid floats clear of the hinge and above the face.

guided-luna.observation: The tall open vessel with a side loop has no discernible compass needle or hinged lid.

reviewed-luna.observation: The tall open vessel with a side loop has no discernible compass needle or hinged lid.

briefs.title: Field camera
briefs.brief: A field camera with a prominent front lens barrel and a raised off-center viewfinder.

guided-luna.observation: The short front barrel, bright glass and raised offset finder clearly identify a compact camera through the turn.

raw-luna.observation: A projecting dark barrel and small finder give it the camera silhouette. The pale lens sits low on the barrel.

guided-terra.observation: The oversized front lens and offset pale finder hold up in all views, with a grip and dark body supporting them.

reviewed-luna.observation: The short front barrel, bright glass and raised offset finder clearly identify a compact camera through the turn.

briefs.title: Rain boot
briefs.brief: A single rain boot with an open cuff and a projecting toe above a dark sole.

guided-luna.observation: The projecting toe and collar suggest a boot. The cuff encloses a broad orange surface with little sign of an opening.

raw-luna.observation: The stepped toe and dark sole can be seen in profile. A flat square black plate closes the top.

guided-terra.observation: A rounded toe and slender shaft sit on a conspicuous dark sole. The dark rim surrounds a solid-looking orange top.

reviewed-luna.observation: The projecting toe and collar suggest a boot. The cuff encloses a broad orange surface with little sign of an opening.

briefs.title: Field radio
briefs.brief: A handheld radio with a long antenna and a front speaker grille beneath a small screen.

raw-luna.observation: The bright screen and three light speaker slats separate clearly below the tall antenna at game size.

guided-luna.observation: The antenna and narrow top display survive, but the broad front is blank where a speaker grille should be.

guided-terra.observation: The screen and grille read clearly on a narrow radio. A detached pale speck beside the antenna adds noise.

reviewed-luna.observation: The antenna and narrow top display survive, but the broad front is blank where a speaker grille should be.

briefs.title: Ferry kiosk
briefs.brief: A ticket kiosk with an overhanging roof and a service window with a projecting counter.

guided-luna.observation: The framed dark service window, inset opening and projecting counter stay visible below the overhanging roof.

guided-terra.observation: A broad service opening and contrasting shelf give this compact booth a clear kiosk silhouette.

raw-luna.observation: The window and projecting counter read at game size. The very large flared roof competes with the service opening.

reviewed-luna.observation: The framed dark service window, inset opening and projecting counter stay visible below the overhanging roof.

briefs.title: Handcart
briefs.brief: A two-wheeled box handcart with two long tow handles extending from the open load bed.

guided-terra.observation: Two shafts extend from an open vessel, but the dark wheel shapes float outside its sides and the load bed reads as a tub.

guided-luna.observation: The wheels and paired handles identify a cart. The upper brown slab closes the cargo opening.

raw-luna.observation: Two handles and a low box suggest a handcart. The wheels look like flat skids and the open bed is difficult to distinguish.

reviewed-luna.observation: The bed is now obviously open and has paired handles. The low horizontal pucks under the box still read poorly as wheels.

briefs.title: Trail gate
briefs.brief: A walk-through trail gate with a broad open passage and an off-center hanging trail marker.

guided-luna.observation: A wide open passage, substantial overhead beam and off-center suspended tag read cleanly through the turn.

guided-terra.observation: The open gate and round hanging marker read at sprite size. The dark suspension is so thin that the marker can appear to float.

raw-luna.observation: The bright off-center tag reads against the open space. The black arm supporting it is conspicuous near the right post.

reviewed-luna.observation: A wide open passage, substantial overhead beam and off-center suspended tag read cleanly through the turn.

briefs.title: Signal buoy
briefs.brief: A floating navigation buoy with a wide banded float and a small beacon on a narrow mast.

guided-luna.observation: A bright band wraps the tapered float, and a small green beacon is visibly mounted above it on a thin mast.

raw-luna.observation: A short mast and bright beacon rise from a broad orange float. The sides have no legible contrasting band.

guided-terra.observation: A dark belt encircles the low float. A narrow mast supports a bright capped beacon.

reviewed-luna.observation: A bright band wraps the tapered float, and a small green beacon is visibly mounted above it on a thin mast.

briefs.title: Footbridge
briefs.brief: A short plank footbridge with low railings on both sides and open approaches at both ends.

raw-luna.observation: Only a few deck seams show between tall solid side walls. From most views it looks more like a tray than a low footbridge.

guided-luna.observation: The tall slab sides enclose a plain deck, leaving little sign of the requested low railings or individual planks.

guided-terra.observation: Open railings flank an obvious sequence of transverse boards. Both ends are accessible and the silhouette reads across the turn.

reviewed-luna.observation: The tall slab sides enclose a plain deck, leaving little sign of the requested low railings or individual planks.

briefs.title: Marsh heron
briefs.brief: A long-legged heron with a bent neck and long bill, standing in profile or three-quarter view.

guided-terra.observation: The long legs, bent neck and horizontal pointed bill make a recognizable wader even in the tiny profile.

guided-luna.observation: A small bird has a short forward bill, while a second tall spike and floating tip rise above its head.

raw-luna.observation: Long legs and an orange bill give it a wading-bird profile. Its neck is a straight post and the trunk is very square.

reviewed-luna.observation: A small bird has a short forward bill, while a second tall spike and floating tip rise above its head.

briefs.title: Pack turtle
briefs.brief: A low four-legged turtle with a domed shell and a cargo parcel visibly strapped on top.

guided-terra.observation: A low green head protrudes below a domed shell and parcel. The pale crossbar projects sideways from the parcel and does not wrap over it.

guided-luna.observation: The cargo is visible, but the taller legs, round muzzle and separate body masses suggest a pack mammal more than a turtle.

raw-luna.observation: The parcel sits on a broad green roof-shaped mass. Several gray feet appear detached, and the top of the parcel has no visible strap.

reviewed-luna.observation: The cargo is visible, but the taller legs, round muzzle and separate body masses suggest a pack mammal more than a turtle.

briefs.title: Fox courier
briefs.brief: A standing fox courier with pointed ears, a large pale-tipped tail and a side mailbag.

guided-luna.observation: The side bag and pale tail tip are visible. The round cream face, separated ear tips and pole-shaped tail make the animal ambiguous.

raw-luna.observation: The pointed ears, contrasting tail tip and square mailbag read as a fox courier. The bag and tail crowd its side profile.

guided-terra.observation: Two dark ears, a pale-tipped tail and a satchel on a diagonal strap identify the courier. The narrow straight tail and plain muzzle weaken the character.

reviewed-luna.observation: The fuller pale-tipped tail improves the profile, but the ears are detached and the face still does little to identify a fox.

briefs.title: Survey crab
briefs.brief: A low survey robot with splayed crab legs, two raised front pincers and one bright sensor.

guided-terra.observation: The low splayed robot and bright front eye read well. Its raised arms end in single pointed tips without distinct pincer shapes.

raw-luna.observation: A mint sensor survives, but the scattered gray pieces and upright orange pyramids do not form clear legs and raised pincers.

guided-luna.observation: The thin splayed legs and sensor suggest a survey robot. Its two single tapered spikes scarcely read as claws.

reviewed-luna.observation: The thin splayed legs and sensor suggest a survey robot. Its two single tapered spikes scarcely read as claws.

briefs.title: Lighthouse keeper
briefs.brief: A standing lighthouse keeper wearing a brimmed rain hat and holding a glowing hand lantern clear of the coat.

raw-luna.observation: An overhanging rain hat, coat and bright hand lantern are visible at game size. The very flat hat loses its crown in profile.

guided-terra.observation: A brim and crown sit above a long coat. The keeper holds a bright lantern clear of the side, though the straight arm reads as a stick.

guided-luna.observation: The lamp and hands appear on a small figure, but the brimmed hat visibly floats above the face through the turn.

reviewed-luna.observation: The lamp and hands appear on a small figure, but the brimmed hat visibly floats above the face through the turn.

briefs.title: Estuary rowboat
briefs.brief: A small open rowboat with a pointed bow, a seat across its interior and two oars lying out to its sides.

raw-luna.observation: The cross-seat and long oars suggest a boat. The hull looks solid and several oar components visibly float away from it.

guided-luna.observation: A tapered open hull, transverse bench and two continuous oars read together in several directions.

guided-terra.observation: The bench, open interior and oars are visible, but the broad circular hull lacks the requested pointed bow.

reviewed-luna.observation: A tapered open hull, transverse bench and two continuous oars read together in several directions.

briefs.title: Reading lamp
briefs.brief: A desk lamp with a broad foot, a bent arm and a downward-facing shade with a light inside.

raw-luna.observation: A broad foot and bent stand support a recognizable desk shade. There is no visible light inside the shade.

guided-terra.observation: A bright bulb and bent support stand on a broad foot. The orange shade narrows downward above the bulb and reads as upward-facing.

guided-luna.observation: The domed shade and foot identify a lamp, but the thin stand lacks a clear elbow and the shade shows little interior light.

reviewed-luna.observation: The bulb and arm joint are easier to see, but the shade tapers toward the bulb and looks upward-facing.

briefs.title: Acorn squirrel
briefs.brief: A seated squirrel with pointed ears, a big upswept tail and a single acorn visibly held against its chest.

guided-terra.observation: The pointed ears, upright broad tail, haunch and acorn against the chest read as a seated squirrel. The ball-shaped tail tip is awkward.

raw-luna.observation: Pointed ears and a chest object are visible, but the tall squared tail and upright body make the squirrel hard to identify.

guided-luna.observation: A round-headed upright figure has pointed ears and a thin club tail. Its seated posture and acorn are difficult to distinguish.

reviewed-luna.observation: The curved mass of the tail is clearer. The figure still stands upright and the acorn does not read at game size.

briefs.title: Travel accordion
briefs.brief: A portable accordion with folded bellows between two contrasting end boxes and pale keys along one end.

raw-luna.observation: The contrasting ends, repeated bellows and row of pale keys identify an accordion. The key bank looks like small dots at game size.

guided-terra.observation: A bank of pale keys flanks clearly folded bellows between two contrasting end blocks, readable through the turn.

guided-luna.observation: Contrasting end cases enclose repeated brown and pale folds. The pale keys are visible on the end, though they resemble buttons in profile.

reviewed-luna.observation: Contrasting end cases enclose repeated brown and pale folds. The pale keys are visible on the end, though they resemble buttons in profile.

transfer.title: Dune camera
transfer.brief: A field photographer's camera with a long telephoto barrel, a pale band around the barrel and a bright shutter button on top.

forms.observation: A long horizontal lens projects from the camera, with the cream band around it and a bright button on top.

references.observation: The camera body and button read, but the pale ring floats horizontally beside the upright lens form and does not encircle a telephoto barrel.

transfer.title: First-aid pack
transfer.brief: A freestanding first-aid backpack with a large pale cross on the front and a contrasting cylindrical bottle secured to one side.

forms.observation: A large cream cross reads immediately on the front. The handle, pack and side-mounted capped bottle turn together.

references.observation: The pack and side canister read well. The small cream marks are largely hidden by front pockets and do not form a recognizable cross.

transfer.title: Sampling robot
transfer.brief: A low, many-legged sampling robot with one bright front eye and a shallow contrasting sample tray that sits open on its back.

references.observation: Splayed gray legs, a single bright forward eye and a shallow rimmed tray are visible. The orange supports frame the tray.

forms.observation: A pale open dish contrasts with a low dark chassis and mint eye. The splayed legs read, though they become thin at game size.

transfer.title: Trail boardwalk
transfer.brief: A short wooden footbridge with open approaches, low rails and a bright upright trail marker at each end.

references.observation: The two entries stay open, signs mark both ends and low open rails run parallel to the planked deck.

forms.observation: The two pale markers are visible. Tall slab walls enclose the deck and obscure the short open-railed walkway silhouette.
